verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Vanta-hosted services: a 'Vanta instance' per region, Vanta-hosted MCP servers, and a FedRAMP gov API endpoint. Private integrations for on-premise systems connect those systems into hosted Vanta and do not let customers self-host the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
